items.heading: These Sit Alongside the General
items.text: These sit alongside the general questions worth asking any provider. For coaching specifically, four things determine whether the engagement actually produces sustained change.

items.heading: Before Evaluating Coaching Services Specifically,
items.text: Before evaluating coaching services specifically, it's worth confirming coaching is the right fit at all.

items.heading: A Service Can Call Itself
items.text: A service can call itself coaching and still deliver a single pep talk with a subscription attached. These four signs separate the two, on top of the usual provider red flags, hidden pricing, guaranteed outcomes.

items.heading: Ask Directly What the Check
items.text: Ask directly what the check-in cadence is and whether it's scheduled in advance, not left to "whenever you need it.".

items.heading: A Real Coaching Plan
items.text: A real coaching plan is tied to specific goals and gets revisited as your situation changes, not set once and forgotten.

items.heading: Know Who Is Actually Coaching
items.text: Know who is actually coaching you, the methodology sets the ceiling, but the person applying it still needs real training.
